name: Roj Kurdish Calendar
description:
Kurdish solar calendar in the top bar, in Sorani (ckb) and Kurmanji (kmr).

• Kurdish day numbers with optional Gregorian, Persian and Islamic numbers in every day card
• Fully configurable strftime patterns for the panel and the popup
• Sorani ezafe (ی), Eastern Arabic digits, month and weekday name variants
• Kurdish events, plus your own JSON files and .ics calendars (local or online)
• Separate fonts for Latin and Arabic-script text: Manrope, Vazirmatn, Estedad, Sahel, any installed font or a font file
• Built-in date converter, guide, light/dark/system themes and settings backup

Powered by tsroj.
